claims.text: The EU's AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 to ensure that obligations are implemented only as institutional capacity and technology mature [Source: ev-1].
This deliberate scheduling also serves as a compliance roadmap, leveraging the "Brussels effect" to export these standards to providers worldwide [Source: ev-1].

Regarding the specific deadlines and requirements between 2024 and the subsequent phase-in dates provided in the evidence:
*   **August 1, 2024:** The law officially entered into force after being published on July 12, 2024 [Source: ev-1].
